contentEn:
When damage hits your BC home, knowing how your insurance works means the difference between a smooth payout and a months-long dispute. In BC, home renovation insurance claims are governed by the Insurance Act and reviewed by BCFIRA. Reno Stars has helped dozens of Greater Vancouver homeowners document damage, complete claim forms correctly, and get restorations underway without delay.

The BC Insurance Act sets a hard 12-month deadline from the date of loss to file. Miss that window and your insurer can legally deny payment regardless of how valid your claim is. Document everything immediately — the adjuster will ask for receipts, photos, and contractor estimates before authorizing any payout.

What does a standard BC home renovation insurance policy actually cover?

BC home insurance typically covers fire, smoke, water escaping from pipes or appliances, windstorms, and falling objects. It does not cover gradual leaks left unreported, rot from deferred maintenance, or renovations done without permits. A burst poly-B pipe that soaked your kitchen overnight is a covered peril; the slow drip under your sink that caused mold over six months is typically excluded as maintenance failure.

Most BC homeowners carry a $1,000 deductible. If your claim is for $22,000 in water damage, the insurer sends $21,000 if approved.

Does insurance pay for a full kitchen or bathroom renovation in BC?

Insurance covers the cost to restore your home to its pre-loss condition, not to upgrade it. If your ten-year-old kitchen was destroyed by a covered peril, the insurer pays depreciated value for materials of similar age and quality — any upgrade you want is out of pocket. Reno Stars provides detailed line-item estimates to support your claim.

How long does a BC home renovation insurance claim take?

Straightforward claims with complete documentation resolve in four to six weeks. Complex claims involving structural damage or disputes can take three to six months. BCFIRA data shows roughly 18% of closed claims involve a dispute, which extends timelines significantly.

If the insurer's estimate is too low, you have the right under the Insurance Act to request an appraisal. Reno Stars provides detailed line-item estimates to support your position in disputes.

What to do if your claim is underpaid or denied

If your insurer's offer does not cover the actual cost of restoration, you can: request a detailed breakdown in writing, supply your own contractor's estimate as counter-evidence, request appraisal under the Insurance Act, or escalate to BCFIRA. Document every communication in writing — verbal promises are unenforceable.

Poly-B Pipe Claims: A Special Category in BC

BC has one of the highest rates of poly-B piping failures in Canada. Many Greater Vancouver homes built between 1980 and 1995 have poly-B pipes. If a poly-B pipe fails and damages your home, document the burst pipe with photos before repair, get a licensed plumber's report, and file the claim immediately. Insurers have specific procedures for poly-B claims. Reno Stars has worked with homeowners on post-poly-B-failure kitchen and bathroom renovations in Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Coquitlam, and Surrey.

FAQ

Does BC home insurance cover a renovation I am already doing?

No. Insurance covers sudden, accidental damage — not damage to work in progress. If a pipe bursts during your renovation, coverage depends on whether the damage was caused by the renovation work or a pre-existing condition.

Do I need a contractor's estimate for my insurance claim?

Yes. Insurers require at least one independent contractor's estimate. Reno Stars provides detailed line-item estimates specifically formatted for insurance claims in Greater Vancouver.

Will filing a claim raise my premiums?

Usually, yes — particularly for water damage claims. Your insurer cannot penalize you for a claim that was not your fault (e.g., fire, windstorm), but at-fault water claims often affect renewals.

當損失發生在您的BC省住宅，了解保險運作方式意味著快速理賠與長達數月的爭議之間的差別。在BC省，住宅裝修保險理賠受《保險法》規範，由BCFIRA監管。Reno Stars已幫助大溫哥華地區數十位屋主記錄損失、正確填寫理賠表格，並迅速啟動修復工程。

BC省《保險法》設定了從損失發生之日起12個月的嚴格理賠申請截止期限。無論您的理賠多麼有效，超過該期限保險公司可合法拒絕賠償。立即記錄一切——理算師在批准任何付款前會要求收據、照片和承建商估算。

BC省標準住宅裝修保險究竟涵蓋哪些範圍？

BC省住宅保險通常涵蓋火災、煙霧、水管或電器漏水、風災和墜落物造成的損失。不涵蓋的範圍包括：未及時報告的漸進性滲漏、維護不當造成的腐爛，以及無許可證裝修工程。一條爆裂的poly-B管道在一夜之間浸沒您的廚房，屬於受保危險；而水槽下緩慢滲漏六個月後引發發霉，通常被列為維護不當而不獲賠償。

大多數BC省屋主的基本免賠額為1,000加元。如果您的理賠金額為22,000加元的水損，保險公司在批准後支付21,000加元。

保險是否支付BC省廚房或浴室的全部裝修費用？

保險支付將住宅恢復至損失前狀態的費用，而非升級費用。如果您十年歷史的廚房被受保危險摧毀，保險公司按相同年期的同類材料折舊值賠償——任何您想要的升級都需自費。Reno Stars提供詳細的分項估算，支持您的理賠。

BC省住宅裝修保險理賠需要多長時間？

文件齊全的簡單理賠可在四至六週內結案。涉及結構損壞或爭議的複雜理賠可能需要三至六個月。BCFIRA數據顯示約18%的已結理賠案件涉及爭議，大幅延長處理時間。

如果保險公司估價過低，您有權根據《保險法》申請評估鑒定。Reno Stars提供詳細的逐項估算，支持理賠爭議中的專業立場。

如果理賠金額不足或被拒絕，該怎麼辦

如果保險公司的報價不能覆蓋實際修復費用，您可以：書面要求詳細breakdown、提供您自己的承建商估價作為反證、根據《保險法》要求評估、或升級至BCFIRA。以書面記錄每一次溝通——口頭承諾不可執行。

Poly-B管道理賠：BC省的特殊類別

BC省是加拿大poly-B管道故障率最高的地區之一。眾多1980年至1995年間建造的大溫哥華住宅使用poly-B管道。如果poly-B管道故障並損壞您的住宅，請在維修前拍攝爆裂管道照片、獲取持牌水喉匠報告，並立即提交理賠申請。保險公司對poly-B理賠有特定程序。Reno Stars曾在大溫哥華、 本拿比、列治文、高貴林和素里，協助屋主進行poly-B管道故障後的廚房和浴室裝修。

常見問題

BC省住宅保險是否涵蓋我正在進行的裝修？

不。保險涵蓋突發、意外的損失——而非施工中工程造成的損壞。如果管道在裝修期間爆裂，是否受保取決於損失是由裝修工程還是原有狀況造成。

申請理賠需要承建商估價嗎？

需要。保險公司至少需要一份獨立承建商的估價。Reno Stars提供專門為大溫哥華保險理賠格式設計的詳細分項估算。

提交理賠會提高我的保費嗎？

通常會——尤其是水損理賠。非人為過失的理賠（如火災、風災）保險公司不能因此處罰您，但人為過失的水損理賠常會影響續保。
